edit.description: the OrderContext each case orders over
the real-chain fixture an order hook can be captured through

summary: the package order cases order over the `blockedBy` graph the engine's own selection composed, not a second one the case spells by the same rule

per.section: A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote

acceptance: every `OrderContext` the order cases read comes from the engine's own selection over a real queue on disk, so a change to the engine's composition rule reds them; no case composes `blockedBy` itself
pins: the package order reads the blockedBy graph the engine's selection composed
an order case over a queue with no blocker still receives a context the engine built
notes: `blockedByGraph` is private to `src/selection.ts`, so the cases compose the map off their fixture queue by the same rule — two spellings, and a change to the engine's leaves these green. The hook is already handed the real context in production (`src/selection.ts`'s one call site), so the capture needs no new engine surface; `tests/harnessChain.test.ts` pins the wiring by identity and is not this work.
